name: ClassLink Launcher
summary:
ClassLink Launcher is designed to provide convenient access to applications installed on compatible VR headsets used in educational environments.

Users can view available applications in a clear, organized layout and quickly open the application they need. Applications can also be grouped by category, making them easier to find during lessons and training sessions.

• View available applications in one place
• Quickly find and open applications
